body: A wound around belief and meaning: a faith that broke, or a freedom that was denied, leaving you searching.
business: You help others rebuild meaning and find their own truth instead of an inherited one.
shadow: Clinging to dogma, or refusing all belief to avoid being let down again.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
